LABEL: Insight Synthesis
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Measurement, analysis, modelling, research methods, and synthesis used to generate evidence and insight.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: Integrated customer evidence into a decision-ready point of view.
Synthesised analysis into a clear decision direction.

MAPPING_CLUES: direct_evidence when action=synthesised_findings AND outcome=informed_decision: The evidence explicitly connects synthesised findings to a decision.
direct_evidence when action=synthesised_executive_insight: The evidence explicitly records synthesising insight for an executive audience.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: synthesised_findings: synthesised research/customer/study findings/insights/evidence
synthesised_findings: synthesised/translated analysis/findings/evidence/insights into recommendations
synthesised_findings: combined/integrated multiple data/evidence sources to identify findings
informed_decision: to inform/enable/support a business/commercial/product/customer decision
synthesised_executive_insight: translated/converted/connected/synthesised analysis/findings/insights/evidence into executive narrative/recommendations/decisions/actions
synthesised_executive_insight: presented analysis/findings/insights/evidence and recommendations/decisions/actions to executives/senior leaders
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Supported by 2 rich archetype definitions and very detailed mapping/evidence rules clearly defining the semantic boundary.

LABEL: Measurement Design
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Measurement, analysis, modelling, research methods, and synthesis used to generate evidence and insight.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: Owned an analytical measurement approach tied to a decision.
Designed a measurement framework suited to marketing decisions.

MAPPING_CLUES: direct_evidence when action=designed_measurement_framework: The evidence explicitly records designing a measurement framework or methodology.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: designed_measurement_framework: designed/created/developed/established/built measurement/evaluation/attribution/incrementality/analytical framework/methodology/approach (excludes using/applied)
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Supported by 2 rich archetype definitions and explicit mapping/evidence rules that define creation vs usage boundaries.

LABEL: Analytics Governance
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Decision rights, controls, compliance, risk, assurance, and formal oversight capabilities.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: Established trusted definitions, quality controls, or analytical standards.
Maintained trusted marketing metrics and measurement definitions.
Applied trust and governance expectations to data-product decisions.

MAPPING_CLUES: direct_evidence when action=established_analytics_governance: The evidence explicitly records establishing analytics governance.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: established_analytics_governance: aligned/defined/established/standardised/governed/reviewed KPI/metric/source logic/semantic layer/dashboard portfolio/reporting definition/logic/governance/standards/consistency/consolidation
established_analytics_governance: implemented/established/created/defined QA/quality assurance/documentation routine/standard/governance/controls
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Supported by 3 rich archetype definitions across domains and explicit evidence rules defining definition/QA/governance actions.

LABEL: Cross-functional Delivery
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Capabilities for planning, coordinating, delivering, operating, and improving services or work.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: A concrete example showing applied cross-functional delivery.
Coordinated analytical delivery across business and technical partners.
Worked across functions to embed customer evidence in delivery.
Aligned data, engineering, analytics, and business contributors around outcomes.

MAPPING_CLUES: direct_evidence when action=coordinated_cross_functional_delivery AND ownership=owned_delivery: The evidence explicitly records owned cross-functional delivery.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: coordinated_cross_functional_delivery: coordinated/drove/led/managed a cross-functional delivery/initiative/project (excludes supported)
coordinated_cross_functional_delivery: coordinated/aligned the delivery/stakeholders across [groups] (excludes supported)
owned_delivery: owned/drove/led/managed/was responsible for a cross-functional delivery/initiative/project
cross_functional: cross-functional or partnered/collaborated/worked with/across [group A] and [group B]
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Supported by 3 rich archetypes + 1 seeded, plus mapping rules explicitly demanding both cross-functional coordination and delivery ownership.

LABEL: Strategic Analysis
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Direction-setting, prioritisation, operating-model change, and planned transformation capabilities.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: A specific owned outcome demonstrating strategic analysis.
Used structured analysis to shape priorities and trade-offs.
Translated customer evidence into strategic implications.
Connected marketing evidence to growth or allocation trade-offs.

MAPPING_CLUES: direct_evidence when action=performed_strategic_analysis: The evidence explicitly records performed strategic analysis.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: performed_strategic_analysis: scoped/evaluated/analysed/assessed/identified commercial/business/strategic problem/case/trend/risk/opportunity/driver
performed_strategic_analysis: developed/built/created analytical/commercial/business case for strategic decisions
performed_strategic_analysis: bounded combination of performed analysis, business or strategic context, and an explicit risk, opportunity, driver, trend, root cause, or decision case.
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Supported by 3 rich archetypes and rigorous evidence signals linking analytical assessment to strategic/commercial contexts.

LABEL: Audience Insight
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Capabilities for understanding customer, audience, and market behaviour and needs.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: A concrete example showing applied audience insight.
Connected behavioural or attitudinal evidence to customer choices.
Used audience evidence to interpret marketing performance.

SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: No mapping clues, but 2 rich archetype contexts provide sufficient semantic contrast against customer-segmentation and product-insights.

LABEL: Customer Segmentation
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Capabilities for understanding customer, audience, and market behaviour and needs.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: Used meaningful customer groups to change strategy or experience decisions.

SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Only a single rich archetype usage exists with no mapping or evidence rules. The limited cross-role triangulation and missing explicit rules suggest abstention.

LABEL: Research Design
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Measurement, analysis, modelling, research methods, and synthesis used to generate evidence and insight.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: Owned research designed around a consequential customer question.

MAPPING_CLUES: transferable_signal when action=supported_research_delivery: The evidence records supporting research delivery without claiming research design ownership.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: designed_research: designed/developed a research study/programme
designed_research: built/created/implemented/established a structured research framework/methodology/approach or experiment/test/survey design
supported_research_delivery: supported/assisted/contributed to the delivery of research
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Although only one rich archetype role exists, explicit mapping rules and evidence definitions strongly define the transferability boundary (supporting vs designing).

LABEL: Product Insights
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Product discovery, decision systems, operating cadence, and product-specific capability development.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: A concrete example showing applied product insights.
Used user and product evidence to define a data-product problem.

EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: framed_business_problem: framed/defined ambiguous business/commercial/operational/customer/product question/problem (might relate)
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: Only one rich archetype, one boilerplate seed, and no definitive explicit mapping rules for this capability specifically.

LABEL: Tooling Enablement
FAMILY_CONTEXT: Reusable technology application, architecture, automation, systems, and tooling-enablement capabilities.

ROLE_USAGES.expectedEvidence: A concrete example showing applied tooling enablement.
Enabled reliable use of reusable data capabilities.

MAPPING_CLUES: transferable_signal when action=built_reusable_tooling: Building reusable tooling is transferable evidence for tooling enablement without claiming that users adopted it or that it delivered a full enablement outcome.
EVIDENCE_SIGNAL_CLUES: built_reusable_tooling: built/created/developed reusable/repeatable tool/tools/tooling/template/templates/component/components
enabled_platform_adoption: enabled/drove/led/increased platform/system adoption/rollout/onboarding
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASON: One rich archetype usage combined with explicit mapping/evidence rules delineating the transferable boundary (building tool vs enabling usage) provides sufficient semantic grounding.
